chunks: Zurarah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
When the salat is established, speech becomes forbidden for the Imam and for the people of the mosque, except in appointing an Imam.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ: the people present in the mosque
key_terms.أُقِيمَتِ: was established or commenced, referring here to the beginning of the prayer setup through the iqamah
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: an Imam, here meaning the one designated to lead the prayer

ai.seo_question: Is speaking allowed after the iqamah has been pronounced in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about conduct once the iqamah for salat has been established. It indicates that speaking is prohibited for the Imam and those present in the mosque, except when speech is needed to put forward an Imam for leading the prayer.
